name: Collared peccary
desc: Collared peccary (Pecari tajacu): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 4 times near the park in GBIF.
about: The collared peccary is a peccary, a species of artiodactyl (even-toed) mammal in the family Tayassuidae. It is the only extant member of the genus Dicotyles.
